QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] Hilla's Tower
QuestInfo.0: The people of Azwan from hundreds of years ago have continued living as ghosts in the #bRefugee Zone#k. Azwan's shamaness #bMedina#k decides to cooperate with the Alliance. Talk to Medina.
QuestInfo.1:
Medina said Hilla should be in #bHilla's Tower#k to the east of the Refugee Zone. Medina said she will go as well because you'll be risking your life even attempting to scout Hilla... Go to Hilla's Tower.

#e#rIf you fail the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: Hilla's terrible magic almost got you. Fortunately, Medina was able to save you. Unfortunately, Hilla wasn't in the tower, meaning she is probably out in Maple World already.

0.0: East of here is a #rtower that was built for Hilla#k. We'd believed a shamaness would be able to pray better if she was in a high place. She should still be there.
0.1: Don't tell me you're trying to go to Hilla's Tower?

yes.0: I must warn you, back when Hilla was the head shamaness, she possessed an incomparable level of power never seen in Azwan before. Worse still, she's only gotten more powerful through her dealings with the Black Mage. Even simply scouting the tower will put your life at risk...
yes.1: I see your determination clearly. Okay, but if you must go, I will join you. My power is a mere candle to Hilla's inferno, but I am still a shamaness of Azwan. I can help you travel undetected. Shall we be off?

no.0: You made the right choice. Hilla's Tower is dangerous. You needn't risk your life for mere scouting.

default.0: If you must go, I will join you. My power is a mere candle to Hilla's inferno, but I am still a shamaness of Azwan. I can help you travel undetected.
